Two distinct presentation formats in one site

page_copy.pattern: Complex AI research and case studies need presentation formats that adapt to different content types—some material works best as traditional slide decks, while other content requires indexed documentation. The challenge was creating a unified platform that could house both presentation styles with an engaging entry point that makes technical content approachable. The CSS-animated homepage needed to feel modern and interactive without JavaScript dependencies that could bloat load times.
page_copy.action: Built a versatile platform with three distinct sections: a CSS-animated homepage featuring glassmorphic tiles with micro-interactions, two full presentation deck areas for AI voice marketing research and agentic workflow implementations, and a markdown-based index system that auto-converts documentation to clean HTML. The homepage animations use pure CSS for buttery-smooth performance, with hover and focus states that guide users naturally to different content areas. Integrated Jekyll for markdown processing, allowing rapid updates to documentation sections without touching HTML.
page_copy.measured: Successfully delivered comprehensive AI research across multiple formats while maintaining visual cohesion and fast load times. The CSS-only animation approach keeps the homepage performant even with complex visual effects. The dual presentation system accommodates both slide-deck-style research summaries and detailed indexed documentation, making technical concepts accessible to different learning styles. The markdown integration enables quick content updates—new research findings can be added and published in minutes rather than hours of HTML work.
